name: natlang-refunds-example
description: Settle refund requests for several shops: a pluggable eligibility rule, a calibrated verdict under each shop's policy with escalation, refined replies, and a transactional case ledger.

desk.description: Settle refund requests (a JSON file of them, or the bundled requests.json) and record them in the desk's ledger.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: A JSON file with a list of requests, relative to the working directory. Leave it out for the bundled requests.json.

arguments.name: eligibility
arguments.description: Which eligibility implementation serves: the crisp 30-day window (default), the judgment, or both with disagreements traced.

request.text: The tent is still sealed in its box; I ordered the wrong size. Can I get my money back?
